title: No Preview in Peek for certain file extensions / extensionless files (that DO display via file explorer preview pane)

status.label: Fix plan ready for design
status.detail: A controlled text/DOCX comparison can separate Peek provider support from local handler registration.

next_action.label: Design fix
next_action.reason: Reproduce extensionless/.ahk text and machine-specific DOCX behavior before changing provider selection.

judgment.rationale: The original report contrasts Peek with Explorer for extensionless and .ahk text; a later user supplies a machine-specific DOCX comparison. Provider selection is testable, but Peek is not necessarily required to mirror every Explorer handler.
evidence: Original reporter: PowerToys 0.79.0, extensionless and .ahk examples shown in Explorer but not Peek; screenshot and registry question supplied.
Latest commenter: Win10 22H2, Explorer Office preview fails on one system; Peek fails for the same DOCX there but works on a second similar system; opening in Word works.
Live OPEN, Issue-Bug / Product-Peek / Needs-Triage, unassigned; no maintainer reply or linked fix.
judgment.recommended_action: Compare Peek provider selection for extensionless/.ahk text and the same DOCX across the reported environments.

fix_assessment.rationale: No linked fix exists; Peek's extension/provider resolution may differ from Explorer, while DOCX handler registration may be machine-specific.

proposed_fixes.title: Resolve supported text previews for extensionless and .ahk files
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Peek may use an extension/provider allowlist that differs from Explorer's Preview Pane, leaving extensionless and .ahk text without a text provider; the DOCX comparison suggests handler availability is also machine-dependent.
plan: Compare Explorer and Peek for the same extensionless text and .ahk files and record selected providers.
Compare the DOCX result on the two Win10 machines without assuming all Explorer handlers are supported in Peek.
If Peek's own text provider selection is the gap, route these recognized text cases through it while excluding binary content; otherwise distinguish missing third-party handler support clearly.
Add tests for extensionless text, .ahk, non-text extensionless, and handler-dependent DOCX.
verification: Verify extensionless and .ahk text previews in Peek match supported Explorer cases on the same machine.
Use the same non-sensitive DOCX on both machines and identify provider/registration differences.

confidence.rationale: The report provides two useful comparisons, but the selected Peek provider and intended support boundary are unknown.

issue_context.summary: Peek omits extensionless and .ahk text that Explorer shows; a second user reports DOCX preview differences between two Win10 22H2 machines.
known_information: Original PowerToys 0.79.0 WinGet report describes extensionless and .ahk text visible in Explorer but absent in Peek, plus screenshot.
Latest commenter: one Win10 22H2 system cannot preview DOCX in Explorer or Peek, while another can preview the same DOCX in Peek; Word opens it on the first machine.
Two comments total, including a bot suggestion; no maintainer response, assignee or fix link. Live OPEN, Issue-Bug / Product-Peek.
inferences: Peek's provider selection may differ for text extensions; DOCX variance could depend on machine-specific handlers.
issue_context.analysis: Do not assume Peek must invoke every Explorer Preview Handler. Reproducing the text cases plus the DOCX comparison can distinguish a Peek text-provider gap from environment-dependent handler support.
initial_investigation: Reviewed body and both comments through 2024-04-15T18:12:24Z, including the full DOCX comparison.
Bot links are not confirmed duplicates or resolutions; no maintainer response or fix is recorded.
Product-Peek is the apparent owner; no source-code conclusion made in this lightweight pass.

reproduce.title: Compare Peek and Explorer preview selection
reproduce.version_requirement: Current development build; compare 0.79.0 if available
prerequisites: Windows 10 22H2 for the reported DOCX comparison
Harmless plain-text file without extension and harmless .ahk text file
setup: Enable Explorer Preview Pane and use identical files in both surfaces.
steps: Select the extensionless text file and compare Explorer Preview Pane with Peek (Ctrl+Space).
If available, compare the same non-sensitive DOCX on the two Win10 systems described and note Explorer/Peek/Word results.
reproduce.expected_result: Peek's supported text preview works consistently; any machine-specific handler limitation is identified rather than attributed to the text-provider path.
